description: Peer-voted Blockbench modelling quiz. Students build 3D models and vote on each other's submissions.

steps.title: Blockbench Model Quiz
steps.content:
Blockbench Model Quiz

This quiz uses the Blockbench 3D modelling editor. Build the model described in each question, then submit it for your classmates to vote on.

Requires Google Drive to be connected by the teacher before starting.

quizQuestions.q: Create your dream house or bedroom in Blockbench. Make it yours — add whatever rooms, furniture or features you like!
Model your favourite food or drink in Blockbench. Think about the shape and colours that make it recognisable.
Design a vehicle or gadget from the future. What does it look like? What does it do?
Create a trophy, badge or power-up that could appear as a reward in a video game.
Build a scene object for a game level — it could be anything: a doorway, a market stall, a fountain, a statue…
Model your favourite animal or creature in Blockbench using cuboids. How close can you get to the real thing?
Design a weapon, tool or item that could appear in a video game. Make it look like something a player would want to pick up!
Build a robot of your own design. Give it a personality — is it friendly, dangerous, useful, silly?
